name: code-tabs-mdx
title: Code Tabs MDX
blurb: Syntax-highlighted code in tabbed panels, parsed from MDX children.
description: Async server component extracting code blocks from MDX pre/code children, highlighting with Shiki, and rendering in tabs. One block displays solo; two blocks show tabbed as ui-layouts and shadcn variants.
use_when: Showing code examples with language variants (component + install, TypeScript + JavaScript).
avoid_when: Client-side rendering needed — it's an async server component only.
a11y: Tab navigation uses shadcn Tabs (keyboard accessible, focus managed). Code content is read-only.
